key_insight: Soft-MoQE learns input-dependent combinations of fixed quantum feature maps, avoiding quantum parameter optimization while retaining competitive predictive performance.
engineering_relevance: Training only a classical gating network offers a resource-conscious approach to hybrid QML that sidesteps optimization difficulties associated with trainable quantum circuits.
method: Build a heterogeneous pool of fixed, non-trainable quantum circuits.
Train a classical gating network to weight each circuit's embedding for each input.
Combine quantum embeddings through learned soft routing.
evidence_signal: On PCA-reduced MNIST parity, MNIST 10-class, and FashionMNIST, Soft-MoQE outperforms the best single expert, uniform averaging, and a linear baseline, with task-dependent performance comparable to a trainable quantum neural network and orders-of-magnitude lower quantum training cost.
watch_item: Results are limited to PCA-reduced benchmarks; robustness to hardware noise and scaling to larger inputs remain unclear from the abstract.
paper_title: Soft Mixture of Quantum Experts for Hybrid Quantum-Classical Learning
